competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease its Attack Power for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 3 times. Each hit decreases their Defense for 2 turns with a 30% chance and their Attack Bar by 20% with a 30% chance.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 3 times, with each hit inflicting Continuous Damage for 2 turns. Attacking the target under Continuous Damage stuns the target for 1 turn with a 70% chance. If the enemy has an inability effect after the attack, decreases the cooldown of [Fire Spell] by 1 turn.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
effets.note: If the target is under Continuous Damage

effets.description: Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: If the enemy has an inability effect after the attack
